before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV
sales = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Sum revenue by region
regional_revenue = sales.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.bar(regional_revenue.index, regional_revenue.values)
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Region')
ax.set_ylabel('Total revenue')
ax.set_ylim(0, 45000)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
